_comment: Atlas Growth :: pools RECOVERY pass over excluded_officp.csv (RUN-NOTES STEP 5b step 2). The main config's allow-list drops any row with no pool/spa google_type. This pass takes those rows back ONLY when the business NAME says pools — the type+name pairing qualify-leads.js cannot express as one rule. Builders mis-typed 'General contractor', 'Landscaper', 'Concrete contractor', 'Patio/deck builder' come back here. Deterministic, $0, no re-scrape. Recovered rows are routed to the site-text gate like every other row.

qualify_rules._r: Generic trades a pool builder gets typed as. Deny-listed venue/office primaries never reach this file with the allow label, so no venue term is needed here.
qualify_rules.label: not_generic_contractor

qualify_rules._r: The name must claim the trade. Multi-letter stems only (substring trap).
qualify_rules.label: name_not_pool
